brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall
requirements.evidence: Three piece cells (full) in a row at q=-1,0,1, level 0, joined with jointBolts; the rack is a single hanging assembly, mesh clear.
Three hex-acc-keyhole accessories on the back face (slot 1) of each cell: accessory:0#-1,0#1, 0#0,0#1, 0#1,0#1.

Three hex-acc-hook plates (two hooks each, six hooks total) on the front face (slot 4) of each cell. The configurator does not check hook size against specific hand tools, and tools cannot be shown hanging on them as props, so suitability for small hand tools is not verified.

requirements.requirement: Wall mounting actually secured by screws in the wall
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks fit only. Wall screw positions and the wall itself are not modelled, so the mounting is not verified.

requirements.evidence: Material, load rating and strength are not modelled by the configurator; the printed material must be chosen and assessed by the user.

finish.summary: Built a three-cell horizontal tool rack: three full-depth hex cells in a row (q -1, 0, 1). Each cell has a keyhole hanger on its back face (slot 1) for hanging on existing wall screws, and a hook plate (two hooks each) on the opposite front face (slot 4). The open faces are capped with solid caps and joints are locked; check_build reports meshClash clear with no rule errors. I did not add props: the wall-hook mount only accepts cable coils, gaffer tape or goggles, so hand tools cannot be shown hanging on the hooks.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Hook plate
parts.use: Each plate carries two hooks side by side, so you bolt on as many as you want where you want them rather than committing a whole face to a rail.
